title: Separate Schedules for Each Location and Service
description: File separate rate schedules with IURC for each service location and each service class; electric service designated IURC No. E.
compliance_control: Tariff maintenance procedure; IURC filing tracker
monitoring_method: Annual tariff review and IURC acknowledgment log

title: Complete Schedules Including Formulas
description: Ensure all filed rate schedules include every rule regulation and formula that affects rates tolls or charges; no schedule is complete without them.
notes: Every tariff supplement reviewed before filing

title: Form of Schedules
description: All rate schedules must be in book sheet or pamphlet form and in size 8.5 by 11 inches; loose-leaf systems permissible.

title: Change of Ownership Schedule Filing
description: Upon change of ownership control or name file joint supplements withdrawing or accepting schedules; new utility renumbers in IURC series.

title: Acknowledgment of Schedule Receipt
description: When confirmation of schedule receipt is required send transmittal letter in duplicate to IURC for stamped return.

title: Joint Rates Definition and Filing
description: Maintain proper classification and filing of joint rates for services furnished jointly by two or more public utilities.

title: Original Filing of Rates
description: For first-time rate filings the transmittal letter must certify rates do not exceed rates in force January 1 1913 unless IURC-approved increases.
monitoring_method: Triggered review on new rate creation

title: IURC Address for Schedule Correspondence
description: All schedules and related correspondence must be addressed to IURC 101 West Washington Street Suite 1500E Indianapolis IN 46204.
compliance_control: Mailing address standard in filing templates

title: General Rate Case Expedited Procedures Applicability
description: When electing the expedited rate case track file a notice of intent with the petition and comply with 10-month procedural schedule under 170 IAC 1-5.
monitoring_method: Legal counsel review at case initiation

title: Case-in-Chief Filing Compliance
description: Serve complete case-in-chief on OUCC same day as filed; cure any defects identified within 20 days; update working papers within 2 business days of rate base changes.

title: Case-in-Chief Accounting Exhibits
description: Submit comparative financial statements revenue requirement net operating income jurisdictional rate base capital structure and income tax rate with case-in-chief.

title: Rate Base Working Papers – General
description: Submit rate base summary schedule showing beginning balances and pro forma adjustments; include regulatory asset detail and fair value schedule.
notes: IC 8-1-2-6.6 qualified pollution control properties noted

title: Utility Plant in Service Working Papers
description: Submit valuation study plant in service schedule depreciation by subaccount construction budget and pro forma additions schedule with plant cutoff date.

title: Depreciation Working Papers
description: Submit cause number of current depreciation rate order and description of adjustments; if seeking rate change include depreciation study and dismantlement studies.

title: Working Capital Working Papers
description: Submit cash working capital study fuel inventory analysis with daily burn data materials and supplies monthly balances for 13-month averaging.

title: Rate of Return and Capital Structure Working Papers
description: Submit capitalization ratios cost of each capital component weighted average cost of capital and parent corporation financial data.
notes: Parent Rockridge Energy Group data included

title: Rate Design and Tariff Filing Requirements
description: Submit revenue deficiency analysis class cost of service study customer impact analysis and rate design documents with proposed tariff pages.

title: Allowable 30-Day Administrative Filings
description: Use 30-day expedited procedures only for allowable filing types: new service rates new rules and regulations clean energy credit rates special contract rates.
monitoring_method: Pre-filing legal review for each 30-day submission
notes: Introduced by 2024 clean energy credit definition

title: Prohibited 30-Day Filings
description: Do not file increases to existing rates or changes to rules that adversely affect customers under 30-day expedited procedures.
monitoring_method: Legal counsel sign-off on each 30-day filing
notes: Critical: inadvertent rate increase via 30-day is a material violation

title: 30-Day Filing Requirements
description: Each 30-day filing must include a cover letter citing the applicable subsection supporting documentation and an attestation of compliance.

title: Municipal Annexation Rate Parity Petition
description: When a municipality requests rate parity for annexed territory file or respond to petition within statutory time frame; follow procedural schedule.

title: Applicability of IURC Electric Rules
description: Comply with all rules under 170 IAC 4-1 as an electrical public utility subject to IURC jurisdiction under IC 8-1-2.

title: Retention of Records – Three Year Minimum
description: Preserve all records required by IURC rules for at least three years except where otherwise specified by rules or IC 8-1-2-38.

title: Meter Test Records
description: Preserve meter test records with meter ID date test readings technician and outcome; retain records for all in-service tests and customer-requested tests.

title: Meter Location Accessibility
description: Meters shall be located outdoors where practical; indoor meters must be accessible to utility personnel; all meters accessible without undue delay.
monitoring_method: Annual field audit of inaccessible meter complaints

title: New Meter Inspection and Adjustment
description: Inspect and test each new watthour meter before installation; adjust if needed; single-phase and network meters may follow modified protocol.

title: Meter Testing Equipment and Facilities
description: Maintain standardizing laboratory with reference standards traceable to NIST; maintain portable test equipment within accuracy specifications.
monitoring_method: Annual laboratory audit; equipment calibration log

title: Average Accuracy of Watthour Meters
description: Maintain average accuracy within IURC-specified limits; conduct sampling tests (Method A or Method B) to verify fleet accuracy.

title: Individual Meter Accuracy Standards
description: No watthour meter shall register at no load more than one revolution; fast meters corrected; accuracy within plus or minus 2 percent at full and light load.
compliance_control: Individual meter test and retirement criteria
monitoring_method: Meter replacement triggered by test failure

title: In-Service Watthour Meter Tests
description: Use Method A (periodic lot sampling) or Method B (age-based testing) to maintain in-service meter accuracy; remove meters failing accuracy tests.
monitoring_method: Annual review of test program adherence

title: Customer-Requested Meter Tests
description: Test meter accuracy upon written customer request; notify customer of results; credit or debit account if error exceeds 2 percent.
monitoring_method: Monthly review of meter test request log

title: Commission-Ordered Meter Tests
description: Comply with IURC-directed meter tests of customer meters; provide results to commission; test fee refunded if meter found inaccurate.
monitoring_method: Regulatory Affairs tracks all IURC meter test orders

title: Billing Information Requirements
description: Bills must show meter reading dates and readings present and previous; billed quantities; applicable rates; total charges and any balance carried.
compliance_control: Bill format standard and CIS configuration

title: Billing Adjustment for Meter Error
description: When meter found slow or fast issue billing adjustment retroactive to period of error not to exceed statutory limit; notify customer.
monitoring_method: Adjustment review by Billing Compliance team

title: Customer Creditworthiness and Deposits
description: Determine creditworthiness in equitable nondiscriminatory manner without regard to location within service territory; deposit policies must be documented.

title: Disconnection of Service Rules
description: Follow prescribed disconnection procedures including advance notice to customer; comply with prohibited disconnection conditions; reconnect within required time frame.
notes: Winter moratorium and medical baseline rules apply

title: Informational Pamphlets and Rate Schedules
description: Distribute required pamphlets to all new applicants without request; post current rate schedules in business office or online; notify customers of proposed rate changes.
compliance_control: Customer notification and pamphlet distribution procedure
monitoring_method: Annual pamphlet content review; online posting verification

title: Standard Nominal Frequency
description: Maintain standard nominal service frequency of 60 Hz; momentary variations are permissible under IAC standards.
notes: Distribution only; MISO frequency controlled by ISO

title: Standard Nominal Service Voltage
description: Adopt standard nominal service voltage; maintain voltage within permissible variation limits; document adopted standard.
notes: Voltage standards documented in distribution engineering standards

title: Voltage Surveys and Records
description: Conduct voltage surveys using calibrated equipment; maintain records of surveys; ensure customer delivery voltage is within permissible variation.
compliance_control: Voltage survey program and record retention

title: System Monitoring Instruments
description: Install and maintain instruments to obtain daily records of load voltage and frequency on system; records preserved per retention schedule.
compliance_control: SCADA and monitoring instrument maintenance program
notes: SCADA records retained in operations system

title: Service Interruption Reporting and Records
description: Classify and record all service interruptions; report significant outages to IURC within required time frames; maintain outage records for 3 years.
monitoring_method: Monthly SAIDI/SAIFI report; IURC outage report log
notes: Business day definition per rule; IURC notification thresholds tracked

title: Accident Reports to IURC
description: Report to IURC any accident involving injury death or significant property damage in connection with electric service; comply with IC 8-1-2-114.
monitoring_method: Regulatory Affairs tracks all accident reports; zero gap target

title: Pole Identification Marking
description: Mark each pole post or structure supporting electrical conductors with the utility's initials or symbol and a unique identification number.
compliance_control: Pole marking standard and inspection program
monitoring_method: Annual field audit of pole marking compliance

title: Line Construction Standards
description: Construct and maintain all overhead electric supply lines in compliance with National Electrical Safety Code (NESC) Part 2 except where IURC variances are granted.
monitoring_method: Annual engineering standards review; variance register maintained

title: Extension of Distribution Lines
description: Comply with IURC rules governing extensions of distribution and service lines; document extension agreements and cost allocation per IURC tariff.
notes: Extension tariff on file with IURC

title: Customer Modification Requests
description: When customer requests relocation or redesign of utility facilities charge customer for costs of the modification; document agreement.

title: Rate Schedules Public Inspection
description: Keep copies of all rate schedules and rules available for public inspection at each business office; post on RPL website; file all schedules with IURC.
compliance_control: Rate schedule publication and filing procedure
monitoring_method: Quarterly website and IURC filing verification

title: Vegetation Management Program Applicability
description: Comply with all requirements of 170 IAC 4-9 as an IURC-jurisdictional electric utility; program must cover all distribution rights-of-way.

title: Vegetation Management Easements and Rights-of-Way
description: Obtain and document legal authority (easements or rights-of-way) before conducting vegetation management; provide documentation upon IURC request.
compliance_control: Easement documentation and right-of-way management procedure

title: Notice for Routine Vegetation Management
description: Provide at least two calendar weeks notice to customers and property owners before routine vegetation management; notice content must comply with rule.
monitoring_method: Sample review of notification records quarterly

title: Notice for Line Upgrades
description: Provide at least 60 calendar days notice to customers and property owners before upgrading a distribution or transmission line to a higher voltage level.
notes: Tracked in capital project management system

title: Emergency Vegetation Management
description: In cases of emergency or public safety may remove more than 25 percent of a tree or trim beyond easement without customer consent; document emergency basis.
notes: Emergency basis documented in work order system

title: Vegetation Management Standards
description: Apply ANSI A300 standards and ISA guidelines when performing vegetation management; contractors must comply with same standards.
notes: ANSI A300 Part 1 and ISA BMP in contracts

title: Pre-Work Vegetation Dispute Resolution
description: Customer may temporarily stay proposed vegetation management by notifying utility; utility must follow dispute resolution procedures before proceeding.

title: During-Work Vegetation Dispute Resolution
description: Upon customer request temporarily stay vegetation management on premises during work while dispute is reviewed through prescribed process.

title: Post-Work Vegetation Dispute Resolution
description: After vegetation management customer may contact utility to dispute; utility must follow post-work dispute resolution process within required time frames.

title: Vegetation Management Customer Education
description: Develop and implement education plan informing customers on tree and vegetation selection and placement near power lines; update plan periodically.
compliance_control: Customer education program for vegetation management
monitoring_method: Annual education plan review and bill insert verification
notes: Bill insert and website content current

title: Tree Replacement Program
description: Where a tree will be removed offer customer a power-line-compatible replacement plant or monetary payment as alternative; document offers made.
compliance_control: Tree replacement offer and documentation procedure

title: Vegetation Management Representative Identification
description: Employees and contractors performing vegetation management or in-person notifications must carry and show identification upon request.
compliance_control: Contractor ID badge and credential standard
notes: ID requirement in all contractor agreements

title: Customer Dispute Process Applicability
description: Comply with IURC customer dispute process rules under IC 8-1-2-34.5; process applies to all service or billing disputes not resolved at utility level.
notes: Foundation of IURC consumer affairs program

title: Customer Dispute Time Periods
description: Follow prescribed time periods for acknowledging investigating and responding to customer disputes; document all steps with dates.
monitoring_method: CRM dispute resolution timer compliance report monthly

title: Utility Dispute Response Mechanisms
description: Provide telephone written and online channels for customers to raise disputes; train staff to accept and document disputes through all channels.
notes: Phone 1-800-555-0142; written to 400 Wabash Commons Dr; online portal

title: Consumer Affairs Appeal Process
description: When customer is dissatisfied with utility's proposed resolution inform customer of right to appeal to IURC Consumer Affairs; provide required contact information.
notes: IURC Consumer Affairs: 317-232-2712 included in notices

title: Commission Review of Consumer Affairs Decision
description: Either party may request commission review within 20 days of Consumer Affairs decision; comply with commission review process and order.
monitoring_method: Legal counsel review for all commission-escalated disputes
notes: VP Legal and Regulatory engaged for commission-level disputes

title: Utility Information During Dispute
description: During an unresolved dispute utility shall not disconnect service for the disputed amount; continue to accept payments and maintain service.
monitoring_method: Monthly audit of accounts with active disputes

title: IURC Consumer Affairs Jurisdiction
description: Comply with IURC Consumer Affairs investigatory authority over customer complaints; respond to Consumer Affairs inquiries within required time frames.
monitoring_method: Director Regulatory Affairs coordinates all CA responses

title: Rate Schedule Filing Obligation
description: Maintain current rate schedules on file with IURC; file revised schedules before effectiveness; retain copies for public inspection per IC 8-1-2-38.
compliance_control: Rate schedule maintenance and IURC filing procedure

title: General Rate Case Statutory Authority
description: Comply with all IURC orders and procedures in general rate proceedings under IC 8-1-2-42; file complete petition with required exhibits.
monitoring_method: VP Regulatory monitors rate case docket

title: Accident Reporting – Statutory
description: Report every accident resulting in loss of life or injury to person or significant property damage to IURC immediately; follow up with written report.
monitoring_method: Zero-miss target; Regulatory Affairs tracks all reportable events
